<|endoftext|> Ben was a curious boy who liked to open things.

"I'm sorry, Mom.
I was curious.
I wanted to see what was inside.
I didn't mean to be bad," he said.

Do you understand?" she said.

Mom smiled and hugged Ben back.

OK?" she said.
Ben nodded and went to his room.
